sentence: AI human capital raises firm value partly by compressing wage inequality
passage: [Agag et al. (2026), p. 1] "Findings indicate that AIHC is positively associated with firm value, negatively associated with wage inequality, and that wage inequality is negatively associated with firm value." / "Mediation analyses suggest that wage inequality partially channels the AIHC and firm value association."

gemini.note: The passage provides empirical findings that fully support the claim, showing wage inequality partially mediates the positive association between AI human capital and firm value.
